note: Every signal head is its own StaticMeshActor (no instancing). Lamps are material slots 1 and 2 of the mesh (slot 0 = housing MI_jctTrafficLightBase). Mesh default slots: A [base, Red, Green]; B/C [base, Green, Red]; D [base, Green]; E [base, Green_b]; F [base, Red]. Level overrides: most B heads [None, Green_b, Red_b] or [None, Red_b, Green_b]; E [None, Red_b]. The *_b materials use the walker pictogram textures (T_jctTrafficLight_L_Gb/Rb, Emissive 2 on Red_b) - B/E are the PEDESTRIAN heads; A/C/D/F carry the vehicle lamps. All lamps are lit at once today: nothing switches them. Heads stand ~830 cm to the side and ~1530 cm along the approach from each junction centre (4100 + k*8200 cm), i.e. just behind the zebras at 1100 +- 300 cm.
